remarks: Bright and Spacious 2-Bedroom Condo with Great Layout. Welcome to this sunny and inviting two-bedroom, one-bath condo located on the second floor of a charming two-story building. The thoughtfully designed layout features an eat-in kitchen, a separate formal dining room with direct access to the backyard, a generously sized living room, and two well-proportioned bedrooms. The pet-friendly complex offers shared laundry facilities, and an in-unit washer adds extra convenience to daily life. HOA cover heat, hot water, and cooking gas. This unit also includes up to two reserved parking spaces and a small storage area for added practicality. Perfectly situated for commuters and surrounded by greenery, the location offers the best of both convenience and serenity. The unit is move-in ready but offers a fantastic opportunity for updates and personal touches-reflected in the attractive price. No rental restrictions
